// <auto-generated/>
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace <global namespace>;

public sealed class EntityJsonConverter : JsonConverter<Entity>
{
    public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, Entity value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            writer.WriteNullValue();
            return;
        }

        writer.WriteStartObject();
        writer.WritePropertyName("Required");
        writer.WriteStringValue(value.Required.ToString());
        writer.WritePropertyName("Optional");
        if (value.Optional == null)
            writer.WriteNullValue();
        else
            writer.WriteStringValue(value.Optional?.ToString());
        writer.WriteEndObject();
    }

    public override Entity? Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        if (reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.Null)
            return null;

        if (reader.TokenType != JsonTokenType.StartObject)
            throw new JsonException("Expected StartObject token");

        var result = new Entity();

        while (reader.Read())
        {
            if (reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.EndObject)
                break;

            if (reader.TokenType != JsonTokenType.PropertyName)
                throw new JsonException("Expected PropertyName token");

            var propertyName = reader.GetString();
            reader.Read();

            switch (propertyName)
            {
                case "Required":
                    if (reader.TokenType != JsonTokenType.Null)
                        result.Required = System.Enum.Parse<Status>(reader.GetString()!);
                    break;
                case "Optional":
                    if (reader.TokenType != JsonTokenType.Null)
                        result.Optional = (Status?)System.Enum.Parse<Status>(reader.GetString()!);
                    break;
                default:
                    reader.Skip();
                    break;
            }
        }

        return result;
    }
}
